text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Dart SDK
      uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
      with:
        flutter-version: '3.0'

    - name: Set up Flutter SDK
      uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
      with:
        flutter-version: '3.0'

    - name: Run dart pub get
      run: dart pub get

    - name: Configure Dart workspace
      run: |
        echo "workspace:" > pubspec.yaml
        find . -name 'pubspec.yaml' | grep -v 'pubspec.yaml$' | xargs -I {} sh -c 'echo "  $(basename {} .yaml):" >> pubspec.yaml'
        sed -i 's/^dependencies:/resolution: workspace\n&/' $(find . -name 'pubspec.yaml')

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add .
        git commit -m "Configure Copilot environment and Dart workspace"
        git push origin main
```
